sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, governing in Trump's Washington.
sentences.zh: 今天，聊聊特朗普治下的华盛顿。

sentences.en: What it's like to be a Republican congressman when the House, Senate and presidency are controlled by your party,
sentences.zh: 当众议院、参议院和总统职位都由你所在的党派控制时，身为共和党国会议员是什么感觉？

sentences.en: but just about nothing is getting done and all the usual rules have been broken.
sentences.zh: 但几乎什么事都做不成，而且所有常规规则都被打破了。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月19日，星期三。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: I'm trying to reach Megan Rogers.
sentences.zh: 我想找梅根·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: Yes, she's actually conducting an interview with the congressman.
sentences.zh: 是的，她现在正在采访那位国会议员。

sentences.en: Oh, no, I'm the interview.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，我就是那个采访对象。

sentences.en: Oh, OK.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: This week, Republicans in Congress were forced to confront the fact that after seven years of promising to repeal the Affordable Care Act under a Democratic president,
sentences.zh: 本周，国会共和党人被迫面对一个事实：在民主党总统任期内承诺废除《平价医疗法案》七年后，

sentences.en: it seems they won't be doing so anytime soon under President Trump.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统任内，他们似乎短期内无法实现这一目标。

sentences.en: It's a confusing moment to be a Republican in Washington.
sentences.zh: 对于华盛顿的共和党人来说，这是一个令人困惑的时刻。

sentences.en: On the one hand, your party has total control.
sentences.zh: 一方面，你们党拥有绝对的控制权。

sentences.en: On the other, your Republican president came to power without the support of much of Washington,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，你们的共和党总统上台时并没有得到华盛顿大部分人的支持，

sentences.en: campaigning against Washington and looking unlike any Republican to ever occupy the White House.
sentences.zh: 他竞选时反对华盛顿，看起来与以往任何一位入主白宫的共和党人都不同。

sentences.en: In the middle of that confusion are dozens of lawmakers like Tom Rooney, a representative from Florida most people have never heard of.
sentences.zh: 在这种混乱之中，有几十位像汤姆·鲁尼这样的议员，他是佛罗里达州的众议员，大多数人从未听说过他。

sentences.en: This is Michael.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hey, Tom Rooney.
sentences.zh: 嘿，汤姆·鲁尼。

sentences.en: Hey, Congressman.
sentences.zh: 嘿，议员先生。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Sorry about putting you on hold that long.
sentences.zh: 抱歉让你等了这么久。

sentences.en: I didn't know you were on.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你在线上。

sentences.en: The music is, it's like a delightful cornucopia of patriotic saps.
sentences.zh: 这音乐听起来真是一场令人愉悦的爱国主义大杂烩。

sentences.en: I don't know if every office has that or not, but anyway.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是不是每个办公室都有这种音乐，总之就是这样。

sentences.en: So, Congressman Rooney, how long have you been a member of the United States Congress?
sentences.zh: 那么，鲁尼议员，您担任美国国会议员有多久了？

sentences.en: I'm in my fifth term.
sentences.zh: 我正处于第五个任期。

sentences.en: So, I was elected in 2008, the same year as Barack Obama was elected to the White House.
sentences.zh: 我是2008年当选的，和巴拉克·奥巴马入主白宫是同一年。

sentences.en: So, this is my ninth year.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我的第九个年头。

sentences.en: And can you tell me how you decided to run for Congress?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我您当初是怎么决定竞选国会议员的吗？

sentences.en: It seems like forever ago now.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来好像是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: My district had a little bit of turbulence.
sentences.zh: 我的选区当时有点动荡。

sentences.en: I don't know if some of your listeners remember a guy named Mark Foley.
sentences.zh: 不知道您的听众里有没有人记得一个叫马克·福利的人。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: A congressional career is in ruins tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚，一位国会议员的职业生涯毁于一旦。

sentences.en: Who left office under a little bit of a black cloud.
sentences.zh: 他是在一片阴云笼罩下离职的。

sentences.en: Florida Republican Congressman Mark Foley resigned today, effective immediately, after sexually explicit messages sent to underage boys surfaced.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州共和党众议员马克·福利今天宣布立即辞职，此前有报道称他向未成年男孩发送了露骨信息。

sentences.en: Jeez, I think I was 35 at the time, and my kids were really little.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我想我当时35岁，我的孩子们还很小。

sentences.en: Just kind of thought that, you know, congressional seats open very rarely.
sentences.zh: 当时就觉得，你知道，国会议席空缺的情况非常罕见。

sentences.en: And this might be my only chance in my life to kind of do something big.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我一生中做大事的唯一机会。

sentences.en: And that I'll probably lose.
sentences.zh: 而且我可能会输。

sentences.en: But that's okay, because at least I tried, you know.
sentences.zh: 但没关系，至少我尝试过了，你知道。

sentences.en: I did not know that at that point that the incumbent was also going to get in trouble.
sentences.zh: 当时我并不知道现任议员也会惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Tim Mahoney disclosed that he's had at least two affairs, including one with an aid he paid off to keep her quiet about the relationship.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·马奥尼披露他至少有两段婚外情，其中包括与一名助手的关系，他付钱让她对这段关系保持沉默。

sentences.en: And so I think that a month before the election, I think that I was like 20 points down.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在选举前一个月，我当时大概落后20个百分点。

sentences.en: And then a story broke, a negative story about this guy, and then I ended up winning by 20 points.
sentences.zh: 然后爆出了一则关于那个人的负面新闻，最后我反而赢了20个百分点。

sentences.en: So I sort of got lucky getting here.
sentences.zh: 所以我能到这里来算是运气好。

sentences.en: But then the district being a Republican district, it hasn't been as cumbersome staying.
sentences.zh: 但因为这个选区是共和党选区，留任并没有那么麻烦。

sentences.en: The power of incumbency is really, really important.
sentences.zh: 现任者的权力真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: The way you're describing it, I wonder if when you won, because it sounded like you did not at all expect to win, you were almost like, oh, I guess I'm going to be a congressman.
sentences.zh: 听您这么说，我很好奇，当您获胜时——听起来您完全没指望赢——您当时是不是觉得，哦，看来我要当国会议员了？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was kind of like that scene in whatever the movie was with Robert Redford where it's like, you won, congratulations.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像罗伯特·雷德福演的那部电影里的场景一样，就像是：你赢了，恭喜。

sentences.en: Like, now what do I do?
sentences.zh: 就像是，现在我该做什么？

sentences.en: So I had no experience in politics at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时完全没有政治经验。

sentences.en: Was it what you imagined it would be being a member of Congress?
sentences.zh: 成为国会议员是您想象中的样子吗？

sentences.en: No, I think that people out in the countryside believe that being a member of Congress, you know,
sentences.zh: 不，我认为乡下的人们相信，作为一名国会议员，你知道，

sentences.en: these guys drive around in limousines and sort of what you see in the movies is not at all what the reality is.
sentences.zh: 这些人坐着豪华轿车到处走，电影里看到的那种生活完全不是现实。

sentences.en: And the first six months I was up here, I slept on my cot in my office and a lot of other people did, too.
sentences.zh: 我刚到这里的头六个月，睡在办公室的行军床上，很多人也都这么做。

sentences.en: And, you know, this was while my kids were finishing the school year down in Florida.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那时我的孩子们还在佛罗里达读完那个学年。

sentences.en: And then we were in the minority the first two years, the complete minority with the House, the Senate and the White House all being controlled by Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而且前两年我们是少数党，在众议院、参议院和白宫都由民主党控制的情况下，我们是彻底的少数派。

sentences.en: It was easy.
sentences.zh: 那会儿很容易。

sentences.en: We just voted no on everything.
sentences.zh: 我们对所有事情都投反对票。

sentences.en: So we were the loyal objectors to everything.
sentences.zh: 所以我们是所有事务的忠实反对者。

sentences.en: Can I ask you, did you like that rule when you were in the political minority of voting no, no, no?
sentences.zh: 能问一下吗，当您身处政治少数派时，您喜欢那种“不、不、不”的投票规则吗？

sentences.en: It sounds like that might be pretty unsatisfying for someone who had dreams of going to Washington.
sentences.zh: 听起来对于一个怀揣华盛顿梦想的人来说，这可能相当令人沮丧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I meant I meant the life was easy in those two years compared to what I know now.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，与我现在所知的相比，那两年的生活很容易。

sentences.en: But by and large, all we do is and somebody warned me of this.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，我们所做的就是——有人曾警告过我这一点。

sentences.en: When you have a divided government, you fund the government to keep it open.
sentences.zh: 当政府分裂时，你为政府拨款以维持其运作。

sentences.en: You try to negotiate around the edges to do that with the little victories here and there.
sentences.zh: 你试图在边缘进行谈判，通过一点点小胜利来达成目标。

sentences.en: And then you do the same thing when we have debt limit votes.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在债务上限投票时也做同样的事情。

sentences.en: But other than that, it's not like I'm a bill sitting on Capitol Hill cartoon.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我并不是那种国会山上的卡通议员。

sentences.en: It's usually if you get a victory, it's because it gets attached at the last second to something.
sentences.zh: 通常如果你能取得胜利，那是因为它在最后一秒被附加到了某个法案上。

sentences.en: That's how I got a lot of money for citrus greening from my district, which is heavily employed by people that grow orange juice.
sentences.zh: 我就是这样为我的选区争取到了大量用于柑橘黄龙病防治的资金，那里有很多从事橙汁生产的人。

sentences.en: You know, I needed to get this funding for a disease that was ravaging our orange groves and it wasn't getting in there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我需要为一种正在摧毁我们橘子林的疾病争取资金，但一直没能落实。

sentences.en: And at the last second, I got a guy from Texas and a guy from California to confront the agriculture committee chairman and say it's really important,
sentences.zh: 在最后一秒，我找了一个德克萨斯州的人和一个加利福尼亚州的人去质问农业委员会主席，说这真的很重要，

sentences.en: not just in Florida and all three states.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是在佛罗里达，而是这三个州都很重要。

sentences.en: So he's like, well, I'll have to take something else out.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，好吧，那我得把其他东西拿掉。

sentences.en: And then he decided he would.
sentences.zh: 然后他决定他会这么做。

sentences.en: And that's how it got done.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样办成的。

sentences.en: Doesn't sound like the kind of heroic moment maybe you might have imagined.
sentences.zh: 这听起来不像您可能想象的那种英雄时刻。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: No, it's I mean, don't get me wrong.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，别误会。

sentences.en: I felt great after we convinced him to do that.
sentences.zh: 在说服他这样做之后，我感觉棒极了。

sentences.en: It was a big victory for my district, one that the growers would see, but not too many other people would see.
sentences.zh: 这对我的选区来说是一场巨大的胜利，种植者们能看到，但其他人可能不会太在意。

sentences.en: But, you know, to answer your question about was it what I thought it would be,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，回答你关于“这是否是我所想的那样”的问题，

sentences.en: it's not as far as the ability to get things done like you would hope if you ran for office of this magnitude.
sentences.zh: 就实现你竞选这个职位时所期望的那种成就感而言，并非如此。

sentences.en: So what were you thinking when President Trump was elected?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普总统当选时您在想什么？

sentences.en: I imagine that this is a moment for a Republican congressman like you elected during the Obama administration that you've been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 我想对于像您这样在奥巴马政府期间当选的共和党国会议员来说，这是一个您一直在等待的时刻。

sentences.en: You have control of Congress and the White House and a chance to really get things done.
sentences.zh: 你们控制了国会和白宫，有机会真正把事情做成。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I was Marco Rubio's Florida chairman, so I was a huge Marco Rubio fan and I wasn't, you know, a big fan of Donald Trump during the primary season.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我是马可·卢比奥在佛罗里达州的主席，所以我曾是马可·卢比奥的超级粉丝，在初选期间，我并不是唐纳德·特朗普的忠实拥护者。

sentences.en: And, of course, when you, you know, you get your nominee, you have to get behind the nominee.
sentences.zh: 当然，当你有了提名人，你就必须支持他。

sentences.en: And there was a moment there where I did not feel like I could get behind him.
sentences.zh: 当时确实有一个时刻，我觉得自己无法支持他。

sentences.en: So I was against a lot of my constituents.
sentences.zh: 所以我违背了许多选民的意愿。

sentences.en: And, you know, there was a there was a real sort of look in the mirror moment there as far as what was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在接下来会发生什么的问题上，确实有过一段“照镜子”的时刻。

sentences.en: So you were on the you were on the verge of opposing him outright, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来您当时处于直接反对他的边缘。

sentences.en: I wouldn't have opposed our nominee outright, but I didn't endorse him.
sentences.zh: 我不会直接反对我们的提名人，但我没有为他背书。

sentences.en: So and that was a big deal in my district where he was very, very popular.
sentences.zh: 这在我的选区是一件大事，他在那里非常非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: So it was just a difficult moment for me as a Republican.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一名共和党人，那对我来说是一个艰难的时刻。

sentences.en: But I do like a lot of the national security appointments that he's made.
sentences.zh: 但我确实喜欢他任命的许多国家安全官员。

sentences.en: I like the Supreme Court justice nomination that he's made.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他提名的最高法院大法官。

sentences.en: What I'm not happy with is when we do things in the House, like last week or two weeks ago, we did Kate's Law.
sentences.zh: 我不高兴的是我们在众议院做的事情，比如上周或两周前，我们通过了《凯特法案》。

sentences.en: It's named after Kate Steinle, who was shot and killed in San Francisco on July 1st, 2015, by a suspect who was an illegal immigrant and had been deported five times.
sentences.zh: 它以凯特·斯坦勒的名字命名，她于2015年7月1日在旧金山被一名非法移民枪杀，该嫌疑人此前已被驱逐出境五次。

sentences.en: Which, you know, is for Republicans and I think a lot of, you know, centrist Democrats, it should be an easy thing to sort of like celebrate as a team.
sentences.zh: 这对于共和党人，我想对于许多中间派民主党人来说，应该是一件很容易作为团队来庆祝的事情。

sentences.en: I think that same day that we passed that, there was a tweet by the president about something completely different.
sentences.zh: 我想在我们通过该法案的同一天，总统发了一条关于完全不同事情的推文。

sentences.en: I heard poorly rated Morning Joe speaks badly of me.
sentences.zh: 我听说收视率很低的《早安乔》在说我的坏话。

sentences.en: Don't watch anymore.
sentences.zh: 不再看了。

sentences.en: Then how come low IQ Crazy Mika along with Psycho Joe came to Mar-a-Lago three nights in a row around New Year's Eve and insisted on joining me?
sentences.zh: 那为什么低智商的疯狂米卡和精神病乔在新年左右连续三个晚上来到海湖庄园，并坚持要加入我？

sentences.en: She was bleeding badly from a facelift.
sentences.zh: 她当时整容手术后流血严重。

sentences.en: I said no.
sentences.zh: 我说不。

sentences.en: So, I mean, that's another problem.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这是另一个问题。

sentences.en: Meaning you got something big done and the world paid attention to 140 character tweet from the president.
sentences.zh: 意思是你们完成了一件大事，而全世界却关注着总统那条140个字符的推文。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That kind of stuff is frustrating.
sentences.zh: 那种事情很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: You use this phrase against a lot of your constituents when you were describing the campaign.
sentences.zh: 您在描述竞选活动时用了“违背了许多选民的意愿”这个短语。

sentences.en: And that's one of the things I've been most curious about amongst Republican congressmen.
sentences.zh: 这也是我作为共和党国会议员最感到好奇的事情之一。

sentences.en: This is our president, both an unusual politician and an unusual Republican.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的总统，既是一位不同寻常的政治家，也是一位不同寻常的共和党人。

sentences.en: He had more support among voters than lawmakers in Washington, if we're being honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，他在选民中的支持率比在华盛顿的议员中要高。

sentences.en: And I wonder how you balance that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道您是如何平衡这一点的。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I think that obviously I have a job to represent my district in Florida and to do what my constituents want me to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我认为很明显，我的工作是代表我在佛罗里达的选区，做我的选民希望我做的事。

sentences.en: And President Trump, despite what you might see in the polls, is extremely popular in my district and with my constituents.
sentences.zh: 尽管民调显示如何，特朗普总统在我的选区和我的选民中非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: And you can sense that?
sentences.zh: 您能感觉到吗？

sentences.en: Everywhere I go all day long.
sentences.zh: 我整天无论走到哪里都能感觉到。

sentences.en: I mean, it is palpable and it is measurable and real.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它是显而易见的，是可衡量的，是真实的。

sentences.en: They do not like the press.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢媒体。

sentences.en: They do not like the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢民主党人。

sentences.en: And so with that, I do try to give the president every benefit of the doubt when it comes to what he wants to do, because that's what my constituents want.
sentences.zh: 因此，我确实尽量在总统想要做的事情上给予他充分的信任，因为那正是我的选民想要的。

sentences.en: Congressman, what do you like about your job these days?
sentences.zh: 议员先生，这些天您喜欢这份工作的什么？

sentences.en: I like that, you know, this is something that you sort of like think about every time that you put your name back on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这一点，你知道，这是你每次把名字重新放回选票上时都会思考的事情。

sentences.en: It's like, OK,
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，

sentences.en: this time we're going to get it right and we're going to be part of something big about when you're an old person sitting around at the Thanksgiving table with your grandchildren,
sentences.zh: 这次我们要把它做好，我们要参与到一件大事中，当你老了，坐在感恩节餐桌旁和孙辈们在一起时，

sentences.en: that you're going to be like, I was there when we did that big thing.
sentences.zh: 你会说，我们做那件大事的时候，我在场。

sentences.en: I am, I think, a hopeless romantic when it comes to politics, and I do want to be part of something big once it happens.
sentences.zh: 我想在政治上我是一个无可救药的浪漫主义者，我确实想在大事发生时参与其中。

sentences.en: Well, what do you want that big thing to be?
sentences.zh: 那么，您希望那件大事是什么？

sentences.en: It could be tax reform.
sentences.zh: 可能是税制改革。

sentences.en: It could be something that we haven't even talked about yet.
sentences.zh: 也可能是我们甚至还没讨论过的事情。

sentences.en: So that's why you keep putting your name back on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你不断把名字放回选票上的原因。

sentences.en: And I'll tell you, the frustrating thing is when you keep just doing debt limit votes and continuing resolutions.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，令人沮丧的是，当你不断地进行债务上限投票和持续决议时。

sentences.en: That's not what anybody here wants to do.
sentences.zh: 那不是这里任何人想做的事。

sentences.en: Now, I can also say that there are some people here that just really love being called congressmen.
sentences.zh: 现在，我也可以说，这里有些人真的只是喜欢被称为国会议员。

sentences.en: It defines who they are in their entire life that they're called congressmen wherever they go.
sentences.zh: 被称为国会议员定义了他们的一生，无论走到哪里，他们都被这样称呼。

sentences.en: That reminds me that my colleague Mark Levervich told me that when he met you,
sentences.zh: 这让我想起我的同事马克·莱伯维奇告诉我，当他见到您时，

sentences.en: you weren't wearing the pin that identifies you as a member of Congress and that you didn't identify yourself as a congressman.
sentences.zh: 您没有佩戴那个表明您是国会议员的徽章，也没有表明自己的国会议员身份。

sentences.en: Why don't you wear that pin?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不戴那个徽章？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I wear it when I go to the floor because otherwise the police would stop me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我去议会大厅的时候会戴，不然警察会拦住我。

sentences.en: But I think that I met Mark, you know, we were out of town and I always thought it was really cheesy when you see members of Congress wearing their pins outside of Washington.
sentences.zh: 但我记得我见过马克，你知道，我们当时在外地，我一直觉得国会议员在华盛顿以外的地方戴徽章真的很俗气。

sentences.en: For me, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我不知道。

sentences.en: I almost think like, you know, for the people that do that, they're almost just showboating.
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得，你知道，对于那些这样做的人来说，他们几乎就是在炫耀。

sentences.en: Some of it has to do with, you know, things like that happen at the baseball practice where people don't know that you're a congressman and, you know,
sentences.zh: 其中一部分原因与棒球训练时发生的事情有关，你知道，人们不知道你是国会议员，而且，你知道，

sentences.en: that they won't target you or whatever.
sentences.zh: 他们就不会把你当作目标之类的。

sentences.en: So I've always sort of enjoyed flying below the radar, I guess.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜我一直挺喜欢保持低调的。

sentences.en: You mentioned, Congressman, the baseball practice in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 国会议员，你提到了在弗吉尼亚州的棒球训练。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about what happened on June 14th.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈6月14日发生的事情。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about that morning from your perspective?
sentences.zh: 你能从你的角度告诉我那天早上的情况吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I, you know, it was our last practice before our game.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，那是我们比赛前的最后一次训练。

sentences.en: We play this game for charity every year against the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我们每年都会和民主党人进行一场慈善比赛。

sentences.en: We get to play in that stadium and pretend like we're big league baseball players and get to show off our skills or lack thereof.
sentences.zh: 我们能在那个体育场打球，假装自己是大联盟棒球运动员，还能炫耀一下我们的球技，或者说缺乏球技。

sentences.en: I think in the eight years I've been playing, I really don't think I ever left practice early one time.
sentences.zh: 我想在我打球的八年里，我真的不记得有哪次提前离开过训练。

sentences.en: And I'm the starting first baseman.
sentences.zh: 而且我是首发一垒手。

sentences.en: For whatever reason, this was my kid's last day of school.
sentences.zh: 不管什么原因，那天是我孩子学校的最后一天。

sentences.en: And I wanted to take them to school that day.
sentences.zh: 我想那天送他们去学校。

sentences.en: So I told the staffer, make sure you let me know when it's seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉我的工作人员，一定要在七点钟的时候提醒我。

sentences.en: And so he screamed out, Rooney, it's seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 于是他大喊：鲁尼，七点了。

sentences.en: Got in the car and I texted my wife at 7.05 that I'm on my way and I pulled out.
sentences.zh: 我上了车，在7点05分给我妻子发了短信说我在路上了，然后我就开车走了。

sentences.en: Receiving shots being fired and there are people running, possibly victims involved.
sentences.zh: 收到枪击报告，有人在奔跑，可能有受害者。

sentences.en: 7.09 a.m., shots fired.
sentences.zh: 早上7点09分，发生枪击。

sentences.en: 7.05, I've still got shots being fired.
sentences.zh: 7点05分，我还在收到枪击的消息。

sentences.en: And apparently at 7.09.
sentences.zh: 显然是在7点09分。

sentences.en: We have breaking news right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有突发新闻。

sentences.en: We are just learning Louisiana Congressman and House Majority Whip Steve Scalise has been shot.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚获悉，路易斯安那州国会议员、众议院多数党党鞭史蒂夫·斯卡利斯遭到枪击。

sentences.en: So I missed it by like three or four minutes.
sentences.zh: 所以我只错过了三四分钟。

sentences.en: And I got a phone call from my mom, like very emotional.
sentences.zh: 我接到了我妈妈的电话，她非常激动。

sentences.en: I'm like, Mom, I don't know what you're talking about because we were listening to music on the way to school, not the news.
sentences.zh: 我说，妈，我不知道你在说什么，因为我们在去学校的路上听音乐，没听新闻。

sentences.en: And then I got my scheduler texted me saying, please tell me you skipped baseball practice today.
sentences.zh: 然后我的日程安排员给我发短信说，请告诉我你今天没去参加棒球训练。

sentences.en: I'm like, no, I just left.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我刚离开。

sentences.en: I just wonder what you were thinking when you found out about the shooting.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道当你发现枪击事件时你在想什么。

sentences.en: I have a lot of things going through my mind after that.
sentences.zh: 那之后我脑子里闪过很多念头。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, there was certainly a sense of guilt that I left and that I wasn't there to help him.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，我确实有一种负罪感，因为我离开了，没能在那儿帮他。

sentences.en: Although I got a lot of comfort out of my best friend back home as a doctor.
sentences.zh: 虽然我从家乡最好的朋友那里得到了很多安慰，他是一名医生。

sentences.en: And he said there was really nothing you could have done for him.
sentences.zh: 他说你真的什么也做不了。

sentences.en: You know, maybe put pressure on a wound or something like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许按压伤口之类的。

sentences.en: But even if you tried to move him, you may have done more harm than good.
sentences.zh: 但即使你试图移动他，你可能也会弊大于利。

sentences.en: And the only thing that you would have done is I'm 6'4", 230.
sentences.zh: 而且你唯一能做的就是，我身高6英尺4英寸，体重230磅。

sentences.en: So I just would have been a big fat target myself and not help the situation anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以我自己只会成为一个大大的活靶子，对局势没有任何帮助。

sentences.en: So he made me feel better about that.
sentences.zh: 所以他让我对此感觉好受了一些。

sentences.en: Listening to you talk, it sounds like you have spent real time imagining what would have happened
sentences.zh: 听你说话，听起来你花了不少时间想象如果当时你没听到那个电话，

sentences.en: if you had not heard that call, that it was 7 o'clock and Rooney, you should get out of here.
sentences.zh: 那个七点钟的电话，那个“鲁尼，你该走了”的提醒，会发生什么。

sentences.en: And that you've just been playing this out in your mind.
sentences.zh: 而且你一直在脑海中推演这件事。

sentences.en: And I've gone over everything to where the guy parked, how far away it was from the parking lot down the third baseline to the fence where he put his gun through.
sentences.zh: 我把一切都过了一遍，那个人把车停在哪儿，离三垒线外的停车场有多远，离他架枪的围栏有多远。

sentences.en: If you think about somebody setting up with a gun along the third baseline, the perfect silhouette target is the second baseman.
sentences.zh: 如果你想象有人沿着三垒线架起枪，完美的剪影目标就是二垒手。

sentences.en: He's standing directly in front of you.
sentences.zh: 他就直接站在你面前。

sentences.en: I mean, the third baseman is actually closer, but because he's moving forward and backward to playing third base, he's not an easy target.
sentences.zh: 我是说，三垒手其实更近，但因为他为了防守三垒在前后移动，他不是一个容易的目标。

sentences.en: The second baseman is.
sentences.zh: 二垒手才是。

sentences.en: It sounds like you're saying you believe that if you'd stayed, you would have been shot instead.
sentences.zh: 听起来你是说你相信如果你留下来，被枪击的就会是你。

sentences.en: Yeah, because the next best target is the first baseman.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为下一个最好的目标就是一垒手。

sentences.en: And I don't know that he was that good of a shot or what or, you know, what would have happened.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他的枪法是不是那么好，或者，你知道，会发生什么。

sentences.en: I don't know what would have happened.
sentences.zh: 我不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know if I would have heard these bangs and just immediately ran into the dugout like some of the other people did or what, but yeah, I've gone over.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不知道如果我听到这些爆炸声，是会像其他人一样立刻跑进休息区，还是会怎样，但是的，我反复想过。

sentences.en: I mean, you can drive yourself crazy going over the what ifs, what would have happened.
sentences.zh: 我是说，反复纠结那些“如果……会怎样”的问题会让你发疯。

sentences.en: But it was just amazing to me that this guy was living in his car, I think, at the YMCA for a couple months and that it was our last day of practice.
sentences.zh: 但让我惊讶的是，这家伙好像在基督教青年会（YMCA）的车里住了几个月，而且那天正好是我们训练的最后一天。

sentences.en: I just don't think any of that stuff was a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 我只是不认为这一切都是巧合。

sentences.en: I think he knew exactly what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 我认为他很清楚自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Because if you wore your pin, the kind of person who shot Steve Scalise might have shot you, might still shoot you.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你戴着徽章，那个枪击史蒂夫·斯卡利斯的人可能也会射杀你，可能现在还会射杀你。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I don't think you can live your life in constant fear of stuff like that or else you might as well never come out of the house.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我不认为你能生活在对这种事情的持续恐惧中，否则你还不如永远不出门。

sentences.en: And I don't.
sentences.zh: 我没有那样做。

sentences.en: But, I mean, with the temperature in Washington, D.C., literally and figuratively right now, being what it is and how angry people are at each other all the time,
sentences.zh: 但是，我是说，考虑到华盛顿特区现在的气氛，无论是字面意义上还是比喻意义上，以及人们对彼此一直以来的愤怒，

sentences.en: it's almost like I think that some people wouldn't even say anything if they didn't know you were a congressman.
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得有些人如果不知道你是国会议员，可能根本不会说什么。

sentences.en: But if they did, then they would just lose it.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们知道了，他们就会彻底失控。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you read my Facebook page, there's a lot of stuff that we have to take down on a daily basis that's really, really bad stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果你看我的Facebook页面，我们每天都要删除很多非常非常糟糕的内容。

sentences.en: Just anger.
sentences.zh: 全是愤怒。

sentences.en: People commenting in like the day after the shooting, you know, people literally would comment in saying there's more bullets coming for people like you.
sentences.zh: 人们在枪击事件发生后的第二天评论说，你知道，人们真的会评论说会有更多的子弹射向你们这样的人。

sentences.en: And it's just like, you know, you know, and my kids are getting old enough now that they're reading that stuff as well.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，你知道，而且我的孩子们现在也长大了，他们也在读那些东西。

sentences.en: So, I mean, that's why it's just sort of like, you know, might be different than it used to be.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，这就是为什么感觉有点像，你知道，可能和过去不一样了。

sentences.en: I mean, to what extent did what happened on that baseball field make you think about your role as a congressman and about your original quest to come to Washington?
sentences.zh: 我是说，棒球场上发生的事情在多大程度上让你思考你作为国会议员的角色，以及你最初来到华盛顿的追求？

sentences.en: You know, when I went home that weekend or the next weekend, I saw my brother for the first time that I hadn't seen him since the shooting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那个周末或下一个周末我回家时，我见到了我哥哥，那是枪击事件后我第一次见到他。

sentences.en: And he's like, my brother never is that sincere or earnest or serious.
sentences.zh: 他说，我哥哥从来没有那么真诚、认真或严肃过。

sentences.en: He's like, you need to quit this job.
sentences.zh: 他说，你需要辞掉这份工作。

sentences.en: And why do you think he said that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他为什么这么说？

sentences.en: I think he was worried about me, that this is going to be like a normal thing.
sentences.zh: 我想他是担心我，担心这会成为一种常态。

sentences.en: You know, I don't think that that's going to be the norm, that we're just going to be like targets of people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不认为这会成为常态，我们不会只是成为人们的目标。

sentences.en: But I don't want that guy to make a decision for what I do in my future and what I decide to do as far as running for re-election or not.
sentences.zh: 但我不想让那个人决定我的未来，决定我是否竞选连任。

sentences.en: I certainly don't want to leave this job because, you know, I'm afraid of people like him because that wouldn't be true.
sentences.zh: 我当然不想因为害怕像他那样的人而离开这份工作，因为那不是事实。

sentences.en: But I think you're getting at this state of intense partisanship in Washington.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你触及了华盛顿激烈的党派斗争状态。

sentences.en: You described it as the temperature in Washington.
sentences.zh: 你把它描述为华盛顿的气温。

sentences.en: Can you talk to me a little bit about that?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我谈谈这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I think that a lot of it has to do with money.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，我认为这很大程度上与金钱有关。

sentences.en: There's groups up here in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿特区有一些团体，

sentences.en: that make a lot of money in scaring people to death.
sentences.zh: 他们通过把人吓个半死来赚很多钱。

sentences.en: This new consumer tax increase as big as Obamacare.
sentences.zh: “这个新的消费者税收增长和奥巴马医改一样大。”

sentences.en: Tell Congress that's not the change we're asking for.
sentences.zh: “告诉国会这不是我们要求的改变。”

sentences.en: If you don't donate $5 right now and donate now, donate now, donate now, if you want us to stop Tom Rooney from doing X, Y, or Z.
sentences.zh: “如果你现在不捐5美元，现在就捐，现在就捐，现在就捐，如果你想让我们阻止汤姆·鲁尼做某事。”

sentences.en: The only way we save our country and our freedom is to fight this violence of lies with a clenched fist of truth.
sentences.zh: “我们拯救国家和自由的唯一方法，就是用真理的铁拳去对抗谎言的暴力。”

sentences.en: And I think that that stuff is really, really powerful.
sentences.zh: 我认为那些东西真的非常有煽动性。

sentences.en: But I also believe that we desperately need adults in the room.
sentences.zh: 但我同样相信，我们迫切需要房间里有成年人。

sentences.en: And I can't tell you how many times I'm sitting listening to people talk and I'm just like thinking to myself, you know,
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉你我坐着听人们说话时，心里在想什么，你知道，

sentences.en: if my dad would walk in the room and we'd give him five minutes, he would have this all cleaned up just because I think that he'd be like an adult in the room.
sentences.zh: 如果我父亲走进房间，我们给他五分钟，他就能把这一切清理干净，因为我觉得他就像房间里的成年人。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that's what Americans need or want, but it just does seem like the people that say outlandish things helps them in political campaigns.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否是美国人需要或想要的，但看起来那些说离谱话的人确实在政治竞选中获益。

sentences.en: And when you say your dad, you just mean like a rational figure unencumbered by politics.
sentences.zh: 当你提到你父亲时，你是指一个不受政治束缚的理性人物吗？

sentences.en: I actually mean my dad.
sentences.zh: 我指的确实是我父亲。

sentences.en: You know, it just seems like a lot of people in that generation wouldn't put up with a lot of the nonsense that we do here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，看起来那一代人中的许多人不会容忍我们在这里做的许多荒唐事。

sentences.en: I mean, there's this there's this cliche about how in Washington, when everything is said and done at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 我是说，有一个陈词滥调，说在华盛顿，当一切尘埃落定，

sentences.en: Democrats and Republicans quietly go to a bar and get a drink that that's.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和共和党人会悄悄去酒吧喝一杯，那是……

sentences.en: No, that doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 不，那不会发生。

sentences.en: I hate to tell you that.
sentences.zh: 我不想告诉你这个事实。

sentences.en: But when I first got elected, one of my best friends was also elected to Congress.
sentences.zh: 但我刚当选时，我最好的朋友之一也当选了国会议员。

sentences.en: We went through basic training together in the military and we both were at West Point together and he got elected as a Democrat from Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 我们在军队一起接受过基础训练，我们都在西点军校待过，他作为费城的民主党人当选。

sentences.en: I've known this guy forever.
sentences.zh: 我认识这家伙很久了。

sentences.en: And we used to go.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常去。

sentences.en: We're at West Point.
sentences.zh: 我们在西点军校。

sentences.en: We used to go to this bar every Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 我们过去每周四晚上都去那家酒吧。

sentences.en: And so we said, hey, let's go have a beer on Thursday for old time's sake.
sentences.zh: 所以我们说，嘿，为了旧时光，周四去喝杯啤酒吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, there was other members of Congress that walked into the room that were giving me like the evil eye that I was in there drinking with a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，有其他国会议员走进房间，他们用那种恶狠狠的眼神看着我，因为我在那里和一个民主党人喝酒。

sentences.en: So I have a final question, Congressman Rooney.
sentences.zh: 所以，鲁尼议员，我有一个最后一个问题。

sentences.en: It doesn't sound exactly like you find the job of being a congressman, the job of being a congressman that you dreamed of.
sentences.zh: 听起来你并不觉得当国会议员是你梦想中的工作。

sentences.en: And Mark Levy, which told me that you had to decide whether to seek reelection in the past couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 马克·利维告诉我，你在过去几周里不得不决定是否寻求连任。

sentences.en: And in giving everything you've told me, I could see it going really either way.
sentences.zh: 考虑到你告诉我的所有事情，我看得出这两种结果都有可能。

sentences.en: Well, I didn't mean to mislead him or you into thinking that I had to make the decision in the next couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我并不是想误导他或你，让你以为我必须在接下来的几周内做出决定。

sentences.en: That's not true.
sentences.zh: 那不是真的。

sentences.en: You can qualify for my job as in May of the election year.
sentences.zh: 你可以在选举年的五月获得我的职位资格。

sentences.en: So but I do really want to be part of a government that finally works.
sentences.zh: 所以，但我确实非常想成为一个最终能正常运作的政府的一部分。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying that it has to work like in some utopian fairytale way and we get everything that we want as Republicans and us and the president are all on the same page with the Senate.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说它必须像某种乌托邦童话那样运作，我们作为共和党人得到我们想要的一切，我们和总统在参议院达成一致。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm realistic enough to know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我足够现实，知道那不可能。

sentences.en: But, you know, I do want to be part of trying to solve problems in a way that shows that the Republican Party can govern and that we've got good ideas that can help this country.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我确实想成为解决问题的一部分，以一种表明共和党可以治理国家的方式，并且我们有好的想法可以帮助这个国家。

sentences.en: And if I don't think that I can do that and I don't think that I can do that when we have a complete control of the government,
sentences.zh: 如果我认为我做不到这一点，而且我认为当我们完全控制政府时我做不到这一点，

sentences.en: then there might come another time where you and I will talk about a different way forward.
sentences.zh: 那么可能会有另一个时间，你和我将讨论一条不同的前进道路。

sentences.en: But right now, I still I think it's early enough that I still have faith that we can do that.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我仍然，我认为现在还早，我仍然相信我们可以做到。

sentences.en: I hope that I'm right.
sentences.zh: 我希望我是对的。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very, very much, Congressman, for your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你，议员，抽出你的时间。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: He's a chief national correspondent for The New York Times magazine,
sentences.zh: 他是《纽约时报》杂志的首席国家记者，

sentences.en: who recently profiled Rooney for a story he wrote on Washington during the Trump presidency called This Town Melts Down.
sentences.zh: 他最近为他写的一篇关于特朗普总统任期内华盛顿的文章《这个城镇崩溃了》撰写了关于鲁尼的专题报道。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani and many others live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过NYTimes.com直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: I would remind everyone that in that proposal, there's a two-year delay,
sentences.zh: 我想提醒大家，在那项提案中，有一个两年的延迟，

sentences.en: a two-year delay which would give us the opportunity to work out a complete replacement on a bipartisan basis with our Democratic friends.
sentences.zh: 两年的延迟将使我们有机会与我们的民主党朋友在两党基础上制定一个完整的替代方案。

sentences.en: So that's a vote I think we're very likely to have in the very near future.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们很有可能在不久的将来进行投票。

sentences.en: A last-ditch plan by Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell to simply repeal the Affordable Care Act and spend the next two years replacing it seemed to collapse on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔的一项孤注一掷的计划，即简单地废除《平价医疗法案》并花两年时间进行替换，似乎在周二破产了，

sentences.en: the day after the collapse of his plan to immediately repeal and replace it.
sentences.zh: 就在他立即废除并替换该计划的方案破产后的第二天。

sentences.en: In a move that seemed to take McConnell by surprise, three moderate Republican senators, Susan Collins of Maine, Shelley Moore Capito of West Virginia,
sentences.zh: 此举似乎让麦康奈尔感到意外，三位温和派共和党参议员，缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯、西弗吉尼亚州的谢莉·摩尔·卡皮托，

sentences.en: and Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, publicly declared their opposition to even allowing for a vote on the repeal bill, making it impossible for such a bill to reach the Senate floor.
sentences.zh: 以及阿拉斯加州的丽莎·穆尔科斯基，公开宣布反对甚至允许对废除法案进行投票，使得该法案不可能提交参议院审议。

sentences.en: In a tweet, Senator Capito said, I did not come to Washington to hurt people.
sentences.zh: 卡皮托参议员在推特上说：我来华盛顿不是为了伤害人民。

sentences.en: I cannot vote to repeal Obamacare without a replacement that addresses my concerns.
sentences.zh: 如果没有一个能解决我担忧的替代方案，我无法投票废除奥巴马医改。

sentences.en: Even so, McConnell is calling for a vote on the repeal bill next week.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，麦康奈尔仍要求下周就废除法案进行投票。

sentences.en: You don't appear currently to have the votes for that repeal plan.
sentences.zh: 目前看来，你们似乎并没有足够的票数通过那个废除计划。

sentences.en: So if that vote fails, do you then begin working with Democrats?
sentences.zh: 那么如果投票失败，你们会开始与民主党人合作吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think we'll have to see what happens.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我们得看看接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: We will have demonstrated that Republicans by themselves are not prepared at this particular point to do a replacement.
sentences.zh: 届时我们将证明，共和党人目前还无法独自拿出一套替代方案。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that President Trump had a second previously undisclosed private conversation with Russian President Vladimir Putin during the G20 summit in Germany earlier this month.
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，特朗普总统在本月初德国G20峰会期间，与俄罗斯总统普京进行了第二次此前未公开的私人谈话。

sentences.en: White House officials insist it was a brief encounter during a group dinner and have offered no details about what the two leaders discussed.
sentences.zh: 白宫官员坚称这只是集体晚宴期间的一次简短接触，并未透露两位领导人讨论内容的任何细节。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器在运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》节目。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
